archetypes.name: dyn-hook-state
archetypes.rationale: New hook counters and sidecars gate blocking behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Stop direct-block and task-output Read clamp state transitions. Check threshold handling, one-shot behavior, fail-open paths, and cleanup on sentinel, dead PID, timeout, and marker re-arm. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
